measured_rules: Timeval copyin and validation precede fd-set access.
Nonempty fd-set accesses require four-byte alignment; otherwise EFAULT.
All input sets are read before descriptor validation.
A ready descriptor present in multiple result sets counts once.
Bits outside the examined range are preserved.
Result sets are copied in read, write, exception order; a failed copyout does not stop later copyouts.
Aliased result sets retain the independently calculated distinct-descriptor count.
Negative timeval fields and microseconds >= 1000000 yield EINVAL.
Timeouts preserve the timeval; delayed data and EOF wake read selection.

subset_differences.rule: nfds > 1024 is rejected before mask-size arithmetic
subset_differences.original_observation: nfds 1025 with empty examined sets returns zero

subset_differences.rule: Every selected invalid fd inside the requested range produces EBADF
subset_differences.original_observation: With only low descriptors opened, IRIX ignores selected unopened fd 31 and preserves its bit
